name: apollo-gtm-enablement
description: Creates facilitator-ready enablement decks for Apollo's GTM teams (Sales, CS, Product). Pulls topics from Notion calendars, validates with Salesforce activity and Gong conversations, and produces Apollo-branded training materials backed by real evidence.
